title: RE: Release 3.2 – status inputs for Monday report

definitions.meaning: Code merged to main with all unit tests passing.

context_note: Reply to the PMO weekly request for status inputs. Earlier messages in the thread are routine reminders.
content:
Inputs for the Monday report:

Development: all 3.2 items are merged, so development complete can be marked confirmed.

Billing API v2 integration: confirmed. PR #482 (billing client update for API v2) was merged to main on Friday with all unit tests passing. Contract tests against the customer sandbox are scheduled to run in staging in Monday's nightly pipeline, so results should be ready Tuesday morning.

Performance: test environment is booked Monday evening; numbers will follow later in the week.

No blockers from engineering.
